metadata.description: Sales goals for AI agents: 99 playbooks, each judged by one number, and an engine that holds the agent to it

plugins.name: nuluno-engine
plugins.description: 24 sales skills (Instagram, TikTok, Threads, X, Reddit, LinkedIn, email, Meta ads, search ads, Product Hunt, search and AI answers, partners and more) holding 99 step-by-step playbooks, plus the Nuluno Engine MCP server: it accepts only the current step with every hand-back item filled in, refuses a profile page or a link that does not exist in place of a published post, waits out the observation window and, when a round misses, makes the agent name one change and run another round
